keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Guests.Desc: Guests may fight here: shady guests and gang members always, other adult guests when they are not kind and have bloodlust, the brawler trait or melee 6 and more. Only guests who are awake, idle, healthy and staying a while. Their bouts are fought for points: nobody gets hurt, and a winning guest gets a small purse from the house take.

defs.ThingDef/HH_BackRoomDoor.label: back room door
defs.ThingDef/HH_BackRoomDoor.description: A plain-looking door with a good lock that only your own people and shady guests can open. Build a room whose only doors are back room doors and it becomes a back room. Gangs meet there and pay for it, and it does not count against the renown of your house.
defs.ThingDef/HH_FightPitMarker.label: fight pit marker
defs.ThingDef/HH_FightPitMarker.description: Marks a fenced arena. Build a closed fence (a gate is fine) at least 3 by 3 tiles inside and put this marker in the middle. Your animals, guests who like a brawl, the colonists you tick under "Fighters…" and, if you allow it, prisoners fight here while guests bet. Bouts with a guest or a colonist are fought for points, so nobody gets hurt. To start one, right-click the marker with a colonist, use "Fighters…", or "Call an opponent" when you are alone. Children never fight.
defs.ThingDef/HH_FenceCounter.label: fence's counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_FenceCounter.description: A scarred counter where a trusted fence buys stolen goods cheap and sells them to shady buyers. Once it stands, gangs sell their loot to it and buy from its stock. It pays from its own cash box, topped up from your till, and "Take goods out" empties its shelf. The owners of the goods sometimes find out.
defs.ThingDef/HH_SmugglerDock.label: smuggler's dock
defs.ThingDef/HH_SmugglerDock.description: A bare landing pad with a shaded lamp. Once it stands, a boat sometimes lands at night and offers a crate cheap, no questions. A letter tells you, and you buy or send it away with the buttons on the dock. Now and then somebody notices the lamp.
defs.ThingDef/HH_HuntingGroundMarker.label: hunting ground marker
defs.ThingDef/HH_HuntingGroundMarker.descript: Marks a fenced hunting ground. Put it inside a closed fence of at least sixty tiles; rich hunters then come now and then and pay to shoot the animals they bring into it. With Dark content and the right ideology a prisoner can be the quarry; you switch this on separately on the marker.
defs.ThingDef/HH_OrganClinic.label: clinic counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_OrganClinic.description: A cold counter for the organ trade, only with Dark or Grim content. Haul harvested organs onto it; anonymous buyers collect them at night and pay without a word. Ideologies that abhor the organ trade will hold it against you.
A dim room with sofas and a ledger nobody reads. Guests pay for a session; they only take what their ideology allows. Open at night.
Guests settle in on soft seats. At least two.
defs.JobDef/HH_FenceDeal.reportString: doing business at the fence's counter.
People were made to fight for bets and I stood close enough to hear it.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_SawFightPit_Bloodlust.stag: Now that was a proper fight.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Interrogated.stages.0.desc: Strangers sat across from me for an hour and asked the same things over and over.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_OrganTradeOutrage.stages.0: They sell organs here. Under our roof. And nobody does anything about it.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HuntOnPrisoners.stages.0.l: a person died in the hunt
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HuntOnPrisoners.stages.0.d: They hunted a person on our grounds. I cannot stop thinking about it.

defs.IncidentDef/HH_HuntParty.label: hunt party
defs.IncidentDef/HH_SmugglerLanding.label: smuggler's landing
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_Discove: Old internal key project, kept for old saves. Never shown, unlocks nothing.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_1.label: the back room
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_1.descr: Old project, kept for old saves. Never shown, unlocks nothing: back room doors, the fight pit, the fence's counter, the smuggler's dock and the drug lounge need no research.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_TheHunt.label: the hunt
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_TheHunt.descriptio: A fenced hunting ground. Rich visitors pay well to shoot what you release into it. From Dark content on, a prisoner can be the quarry if you allow it on the marker.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_BlackClinic.label: black clinic
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_BlackClinic.descri: A counter where anonymous donors buy harvested organs, no questions asked. Only with Dark or Grim content.
